jobs.title: Web Automation Test Engineer
jobs.description:
Caylent is an AI-first cloud services company that helps organizations turn ambitious ideas into meaningful business impact. As an AWS Premier Tier Services Partner and a charter member of Anthropic’s Claude Partner Network, we combine deep expertise in AWS, artificial intelligence, and Anthropic’s Claude platform to help customers modernize their technology, build intelligent products, and move AI from experimentation into production. 
 Our capabilities span generative and agentic AI, cloud migration and modernization, cloud-native application development, data and analytics, DevOps, managed services, security and compliance, and customer experience transformation. At Caylent, our people always come first. 
 We are a fully remote global company with employees in Canada, the United States and Latin America. We celebrate the culture of each of our team members and foster a community of technological curiosity. Come talk to us to learn more about what it means to be a Caylien! 
  The Mission  
 We are seeking a skilled Web Automation Test Engineer to join our growing Quality Assurance and Testing practice. The right candidate is someone who has hands-on expertise building scalable test automation frameworks, with a strong emphasis on reliability, maintainability, and rapid feedback for CI/CD pipelines. Your mission will be to design, develop, and maintain robust web automation frameworks for API and functional testing, enabling our teams to deliver high-quality cloud-native solutions. You'll work with modern tools like Playwright and collaborate closely with developers and QA teams to drive automation best practices across our projects. 
   Your Assignment  
 
 Design, implement, and maintain a scalable web automation framework for API and UI/functional testing 
 Develop test strategies, test plans, and automation suites using Playwright (Python/TypeScript) for web applications 
 Create reusable, modular page objects and components to maximize test reuse and maintainability 
 Implement API testing strategies (REST/GraphQL) integrated with UI tests where appropriate 
 Write clear, maintainable automated tests with robust assertions and meaningful reporting 
 Integrate tests with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, etc.) 
 Configure test data management, environment handling, and test environment provisioning 
 Implement parallel test execution, flaky test handling, retry strategies, and test isolation 
 Monitor test results, analyze failures, and provide timely root-cause analysis 
 Collaborate with developers, QA, and product teams to ensure quality goals are met 
 Document framework usage, coding standards, and create comprehensive onboarding guides 
 Stay current with automation tooling trends and propose improvements to testing infrastructure 
 
   Your Qualifications  
 
 3+ years of hands-on experience in web automation testing 
 Strong proficiency with Playwright (Python/TypeScript) for end-to-end web testing 
 Demonstrated experience building automation frameworks from the ground up 
 Proficient in Python/TypeScript with good knowledge of software design patterns 
 Experience with API testing (REST/GraphQL) and integrating API tests with UI tests 
 Familiarity with test frameworks (pytest, unittest) 
 Solid understanding of CI/CD integration and test reporting 
 Experience with version control (Git) and collaborative workflows 
 Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills 
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills 
 
   Preferred Qualifications  
 
 Xray Test Management for Jira for integrating test plans/results with Jira 
 Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) experience and tooling (e.g., Gherkin, Cucumber, Behave) 
 Knowledge of performance testing fundamentals 
 Docker and containerized test environments 
 Cloud-based test environments and device/browser farms 
 Experience with test data management and data-driven testing 
 Prior exposure to Agile/Scrum development processes

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Platform
jobs.description:
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning. 
 Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.   
 Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office.  
  Overview  
 The Platform team owns the backend behind everything Speechify ships: the public TTS API, payments, subscriptions, auth, consumption tracking, and analytics — serving over 50 million users across iOS, Android, Mac, Chrome, and web. 
 These are systems where correctness compounds. Subscription state has to stay consistent across five clients and two app-store billing systems that each go quiet at the worst moment. Consumption metering has to be exact enough to bill on and cheap enough to run at our request volume. The public TTS API has external customers with their own products depending on our latency and uptime. None of this degrades gracefully — it is either right, or someone gets charged twice. 
 The job is to make your own job smaller. Every system you own here should need less of you a year from now than it did the day you took it, and the reward for that is a larger one. That is the entire growth path on this team — there is no separate ladder, and no ceiling except the one you stop raising. We are a flat organization: people become leaders here by taking scope and being right about it, fast. 
  What Yo  u'  ll Do  
 
 Design, build, and own the APIs behind payments, subscriptions, auth, consumption tracking, and our public TTS API 
 Take on services you didn't write and make them faster, cheaper, and harder to break 
 Establish that a change is correct before it ships, and leave behind the checks that keep it correct after you've moved on 
 Automate the parts of your role that shouldn't need a person, then go take on what that freed you up for 
 Turn work you've done once into work the whole team can repeat 
 Design B2B and enterprise integrations for customers building on top of us 
 Work with product, mobile, and web to keep backend architecture ahead of where the product is going 
 
  An Ideal Candidate Should Have  
 
 Proven backend experience in TS/Node (required) 
 Direct experience with GCP; working knowledge of AWS, Azure, or another cloud 
 A habit of giving away work you used to own, and something to show for the room it created 
 A daily working setup with AI agents you can describe in detail — what runs unattended, what you review, and where you've decided it doesn't get to act alone 
 The instinct to check a result against the system itself — logs, database state, the actual request — rather than against a summary of it 
 Judgment about what not to build, and the ability to say plainly why you dropped it 
 A preference for being corrected over being right 
 Preferred: Docker and containerized deployments 
 Preferred: deploying high-availability applications on Kubernetes 
 
  Interview process  
 Several technical interviews plus a take-home assessment on a real codebase. We aim to finish within a week. 
 The assessment runs in two stages: you'll submit, get real feedback from an engineer on this team, and have time to act on it. Use the tools you use every day. You'll be asked to walk through your reasoning, so bring it. 
  What We Offer   
 
 A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products 
 A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive 
 Autonomy, fostering

We are especially interested in people who have built or operated systems with real constraints: rate limits, flaky third-party APIs, queues, webhooks, retries, distributed locks, data migrations, observability gaps, customer pressure, and cost ceilings.    What we’re looking for    5+ years of backend, platform, infrastructure, or distributed systems engineering experience in a production environment.    Deep hands-on TypeScript experience. We run TypeScript services on Bun, and we care about people who can design clean, reliable backend systems rather than only write application code.    Strong understanding of queues, workers, retries, rate limits, idempotency, distributed locks, webhooks, and failure handling.    Experience operating systems under real production pressure: incidents, provider outages, customer escalations, noisy alerts, slow dependencies, and incomplete data.    Comfort with cloud-native infrastructure. Our stack includes GCP, Kubernetes, Cloud Tasks, Pub/Sub, RabbitMQ, Redis, Postgres, Firestore, ClickHouse, Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry. new_jobs.title: Software Engineer, Platform
new_jobs.description:
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning. 
 Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.   
 Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office.  
  Overview  
 The Platform team owns the backend behind everything Speechify ships: the public TTS API, payments, subscriptions, auth, consumption tracking, and analytics — serving over 50 million users across iOS, Android, Mac, Chrome, and web. 
 These are systems where correctness compounds. Subscription state has to stay consistent across five clients and two app-store billing systems that each go quiet at the worst moment. Consumption metering has to be exact enough to bill on and cheap enough to run at our request volume. The public TTS API has external customers with their own products depending on our latency and uptime. None of this degrades gracefully — it is either right, or someone gets charged twice. 
 The job is to make your own job smaller. Every system you own here should need less of you a year from now than it did the day you took it, and the reward for that is a larger one. That is the entire growth path on this team — there is no separate ladder, and no ceiling except the one you stop raising. We are a flat organization: people become leaders here by taking scope and being right about it, fast. 
  What Yo  u'  ll Do  
 
 Design, build, and own the APIs behind payments, subscriptions, auth, consumption tracking, and our public TTS API 
 Take on services you didn't write and make them faster, cheaper, and harder to break 
 Establish that a change is correct before it ships, and leave behind the checks that keep it correct after you've moved on 
 Automate the parts of your role that shouldn't need a person, then go take on what that freed you up for 
 Turn work you've done once into work the whole team can repeat 
 Design B2B and enterprise integrations for customers building on top of us 
 Work with product, mobile, and web to keep backend architecture ahead of where the product is going 
 
  An Ideal Candidate Should Have  
 
 Proven backend experience in TS/Node (required) 
 Direct experience with GCP; working knowledge of AWS, Azure, or another cloud 
 A habit of giving away work you used to own, and something to show for the room it created 
 A daily working setup with AI agents you can describe in detail — what runs unattended, what you review, and where you've decided it doesn't get to act alone 
 The instinct to check a result against the system itself — logs, database state, the actual request — rather than against a summary of it 
 Judgment about what not to build, and the ability to say plainly why you dropped it 
 A preference for being corrected over being right 
 Preferred: Docker and containerized deployments 
 Preferred: deploying high-availability applications on Kubernetes 
 
  Interview process  
 Several technical interviews plus a take-home assessment on a real codebase. We aim to finish within a week. 
 The assessment runs in two stages: you'll submit, get real feedback from an engineer on this team, and have time to act on it. Use the tools you use every day. You'll be asked to walk through your reasoning, so bring it. 
  What We Offer   
 
 A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products 
 A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive 
 Autonomy, fostering

new_jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer
new_jobs.description: About the role  Peec AI is building the data plane for AI visibility: millions of chats, scrapes, citations, sources, model responses, and customer-facing insights running through a fast-moving backend.  This role is for an engineer who wants to own the systems behind that. You will not just add endpoints or close tickets. You will make our scraping, chat-processing, source-ingestion, and analytics infrastructure more reliable, cheaper, faster, and easier for the rest of the team to reason about.  The best fit looks like someone who can debug a provider outage in the morning, design a better queueing model before lunch, ship a TypeScript service change in the afternoon, and write the postmortem or follow-up ticket clearly enough that the next engineer immediately knows what to do.  We are especially interested in people who have built or operated systems with real constraints: rate limits, flaky third-party APIs, queues, webhooks, retries, distributed locks, data migrations, observability gaps, customer pressure, and cost ceilings.    What we’re looking for    5+ years of backend, platform, infrastructure, or distributed systems engineering experience in a production environment.    Deep hands-on TypeScript experience. We run TypeScript services on Bun, and we care about people who can design clean, reliable backend systems rather than only write application code.    Strong understanding of queues, workers, retries, rate limits, idempotency, distributed locks, webhooks, and failure handling.    Experience operating systems under real production pressure: incidents, provider outages, customer escalations, noisy alerts, slow dependencies, and incomplete data.    Comfort with cloud-native infrastructure. Our stack includes GCP, Kubernetes, Cloud Tasks, Pub/Sub, RabbitMQ, Redis, Postgres, Firestore, ClickHouse, Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry.    Ability to debug across layers: application code, logs, metrics, queues, provider APIs, databases, network behaviour, and deployment state.    Product-minded judgement. You can separate internal detail from customer-safe explanation, and you understand when a “small infra change” has customer, security, or cost implications.    High ownership and low ego. We want people who take responsibility for ambiguous systems, ask sharp questions, and make the team better through clear thinking and kindness.    A bias toward durable fixes. You do not stop at “restart the pod” if the real issue is retry amplification, missing backpressure, an unsafe parser assumption, or a provider limit we do not model.      Tech stack     Languages:  TypeScript, Python     Runtime/frameworks:  Bun, Elysia, Node-compatible services     Cloud/infrastructure:  GCP, Kubernetes, Cloud Tasks, Pub/Sub, Firebase/Firestore, Postgres, ClickHouse, Redis, RabbitMQ     Observability:  Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, structured logging     Product/data domain:  LLM chats, AI search, source scraping, citation extraction, provider integrations, customer-facing analytics     AI/model providers:  OpenAI, Anthropic/Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Mode / AI Overview, plus scraping/provider APIs around them      What we offer    Exciting and challenging work with real impact and ownership at one of Europe’s fastest-growing Series A startups    Regular team events and off-sites    Aggressive equity compensation package    Paid Dinner & Uber home when working late    The most beautiful office space and work environment in Berlin         Compensation: €100K – €150K • Offers Equity    • €100K – €150K • Offers Equity   Find more  English Speaking Jobs in Germany  on Arbeitnow
